text.p: Intercell Corp said Monday it has acquired control of privately-held Sigma 7 Corp for $2.5 million in cash.
Intercell will own about 90 percent of the five million issued and outstanding common shares of San Diego-based Sigma 7, it said.

Sigma 7's BMI Acquisition Group Inc manufactures a variety of proprietary Simm, Dimm and video cards using its proprietary patch technology, Intercell said. The technology is the subject of a provisional patent application filed with the U.S. Patent and Trademark office.
"This acquisition furthers our strategy of acquiring proven technology in the electronics industry," said Paul H. Metzinger, president and chief executive officer of Intercell.
Intercell also said chief operating officer Charles Bauer has been appointed CEO of Sigma 7.
